purpose: Repair the proven Gekta stream blocker in the bounded web-only exact-SHA release without weakening live acceptance. Release run 33194982129 proved the target web image became healthy, exact manifest and RU/EN/ZH public routes passed, but all 12 Gekta stream attempts failed closed with HTTP 503 and GEKTA_SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE after a valid anonymous reservation. Gekta server routes still used raw API_URL/NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL instead of the canonical server-side API base authority introduced for production, while the production web hardening override did not pin the canonical Nest /api base. Reuse the existing fail-closed resolver and pin only the web API_URL to the exact Compose API base.
